answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where nodes must lock capital in a vault to validate transactions. This stake acts as an economic anchor, tethering digital identities to tangible value. Any attempt to dilute network consensus via fake identities forces the adversary to exhaust liquidity, effectively functioning as a digital pigment that stains malicious actors by tying their identity to a non-recoverable financial loss, thereby ensuring security through attrition.
